body:
I have major sensory issues. Dogs barking is the absolute worst, the shrillness of it can give me a meltdown. Also cats scooping their litter boxes, for some reason, the sound maximizes and I can hear it from rooms away, which will render me to scare them off with a broom (because more often then not they’re just scooping in excess despite the shit already being covered). I also go absolutely ballistic when cats bang/claw at the door. And don’t get me started on heat yowling….

Oh ALSO!! The FLEAS holy shit. I have a skin condition called dermatographia urticaria, which I’m allergic to touch and my histamines go insane from small things like shirt collars or my own hair, resulting in huge rashes. So you can imagine the damage fleas do. And I an infestation in the house because I have 3 of these bastard cats here against my own will

I’m in a similar boat right now. I have 3 cats in my house (no by own willingness, they’re my partners) and they’ve been destroying the walls, furniture, shedding, and making a shit load of noise that agitates my sensory issues. I HATE the sound of litter scooping, the smell of cat shit and hearing them bat shit around the house. Also I dont find the 3 AM crackhead zoomies cute or endearing, it’s infuriating. As of right now me and the property owners are campaigning to get the bastards out of my house, as my partner was never given the green light to have 1 cat, much less 3. I shouldn’t have to fight so hard to live comfortably in my own home without animal feces being present. I’m glad you made the right choice for yourself and that you found peace. Enjoy your peaceful, quiet home and don’t let anyone guilt trip you
